name: Little Snowy Owl Studio

tasks.app_description: Write a short, parent-facing description of the app named in the user input, mentioning only features listed in the input.
tasks.promo_text: Write App Store promotional text (max 170 characters) for the app in the user input.

rules.message: No urgency or pressure tactics (dark patterns).
The apps have no AI chat, accounts or tracking. Do not claim them.
Do not use fear of falling behind to sell to parents.
Descriptions should mention that the app is offline, ad-free or account-free.
Promotional text must be at most 170 characters (check the current App Store Connect limit).

_sources: Learner brief and the AnimalPairs and LittleSnowyOwlStudio repository READMEs, verified 2026-11-27.
